notes.title: New Tails Noir Game!
notes.notes:
New Tails Noir Game! TOTALLY NOT A RACING GAME

Hey check out this new game: Tails Noir: Rebel Rush created by our friends who are coincidentally called Soup with Friends. That’s right, more Tails Noir games! Set in a dystopian Vancouver, this speedrunning game will break your leg, make you call your mom, and cry for help.
